description.p: Linux Defender is a Linux desktop security scanner built with Rust, Tauri, and React. It uses host-installed ClamAV for local scanning and offers optional, consent-based VirusTotal and urlscan reputation checks.

ul.li: Select files or directories to scan using the native file dialog
Background scanning keeps the UI responsive during long scans
Clear, readable display of scan results
Graceful handling when ClamAV is not installed
Scan profiles, scheduling, history, and hash-verified quarantine
System audit and desktop integration for supported file managers

description.p: Linux Defender 0.6.0 is a development snapshot. Signed Linux Defender release packages are not available yet.

ul.li: Improves large-scan evidence retention, history and quarantine responsiveness, and daemon path handling.
Adds consent-based VirusTotal folder and URL analysis, urlscan URL checks, and visible upload progress.
Connects standalone YARA scans to the configured host ClamAV database and exposes a signature inventory.
